hypotheses.B1_restricted_tensor_identity_is_exact: The explicit restricted tensor matches native bilinear JVPs to relative error at most 1e-5 for every active prototype.
hypotheses.B2_context_rank64_is_sufficient: A covariance-weighted context rank 64 captures at least 90% tensor energy for every active prototype.
hypotheses.B3_output_rank64_is_sufficient: A covariance-weighted output rank 64 captures at least 90% tensor energy for every active prototype.
hypotheses.B4_tucker64_predicts_heldout_writes: A joint context/output rank-64 program has held-out derivative R-squared at least 0.80 for every active prototype.
hypotheses.B5_tucker128_is_high_fidelity: A joint rank-128 program has held-out derivative R-squared at least 0.95 for every active prototype.
hypotheses.B6_program_is_smaller_than_native_contex: The median smallest joint rank reaching R-squared 0.90 is at most 128.
